clips.title: The story
paras: Priestess Anetta sends you south from Northshire Abbey to continue your training in Goldshire. Priestess Josetta is waiting at the Lion's Pride Inn to guide your next steps in the Holy Light.

Northshire Abbey gives you shelter and your first lessons in the Holy Light. After you learn prayer and divine healing, Priestess Anetta sends you south along the road to Goldshire. There, you leave the abbey's sheltered study for service among the people of Elwynn.

Priestess Josetta tends to Goldshire's spiritual needs from the Lion's Pride Inn and guides rising acolytes. She builds on the lessons you learned at the abbey, teaching you to offer comfort, protect the faithful, and heal the injured. Under her guidance, you begin learning the duties of the Church's servants across the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello again, young priest. The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. After you've completed whatever tasks you have here in Northshire, please seek out Priestess Josetta in Goldshire. She has more to teach you and has heard that you are growing strong in the ways of the Light. She looks forward to tutoring you more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. We have much to discuss about your future and your path within the Light.
